lane: SEE (God's Eye, the Machine view, threats, the map, cameras, the car, measure)

features.name: God's Eye globe
features.does: A live 3D globe you can spin, pinch and tilt, with a search for places, flights, ships and satellites.

features.name: What to show (the layers)
features.where: SEE → GOD'S EYE → the layers button
features.does: Turns 29 live layers on or off in four groups (streets and safety; air, sea and space; weather and hazards; the map), and remembers your choices.
features.note: Ships need a free key outside the Baltic; live traffic on the globe needs the free TomTom key.

features.name: Quick chips
features.where: SEE → GOD'S EYE → the chips under the search
features.does: One-tap Aircraft, Incidents and Radar, each with a live count.

features.name: Live public CCTV
features.where: SEE → GOD'S EYE → turn on CCTV cameras, zoom in
say: show me the cameras on the Strand
features.does: The nearest public traffic cameras in a grid; tap one for a live picture with PREV, NEXT, TRY ANOTHER and Street View. It never covers the layer chips or the keys.
features.note: Only places that publish open camera feeds (London, National Highways, New York, Finland, Ontario, BC, NSW, Calgary, Durham).

features.name: Tap anything card
features.where: SEE → GOD'S EYE → tap a plane, ship, quake or the ground
features.does: A card for whatever you tapped, with its facts, its source, FOLLOW, ZOOM and ASK GHOSTY.

features.name: This spot
features.where: SEE → GOD'S EYE → THIS SPOT bar, or tap the ground
features.does: MAP, 3D, STREET VIEW, TRAFFIC and GO for the place under the crosshair; a tapped spot also gets its address and SHARE.

features.name: Look menu
features.does: Changes how the globe is drawn (map tiles, night vision, thermal, film noir and more), plus SUN and SPIN.

features.name: Road ahead
features.does: Follows the phone and shows your speed, road reports ahead, safety cameras and motorway cameras to tap. Where you are stays on the phone.
features.note: Motorway reports only in the West Midlands.

features.name: The Machine view
features.does: Your city with everything moving, your places lit, and a true count line.

features.name: Street crime, ANPR and speed cameras
features.where: SEE → GOD'S EYE → layers → STREETS & SAFETY
features.does: Police.uk open crime data (nobody identified) and mapped ANPR, speed and red-light sites, with West Midlands Police figures.

features.name: Map sheet
features.where: SEE → GOD'S EYE → THIS SPOT → MAP
features.does: A full flat map with styles (streets, satellite, topo, cycle, rail, sea marks, rain, dark), measuring, GPS and ROUTE HERE.
features.note: Says when it cannot load, and tries again next time.

features.name: Journey planner
say: get me to Manchester by train
features.does: Public transport and walking journeys from public timetables, drawn on the map.
features.note: With no signal the line is not drawn on the offline map.

features.name: Offline maps
features.does: Draws the phone's own map pack when there is no signal.

features.name: THREATS
features.does: A threat level from live quakes, storms, fires and alerts, each saying when and from which feed; NEAR YOU, space weather and launches.

features.name: Near home watch
features.does: Watches near your saved places and says the one next thing.

features.name: RECON (infrastructure look-up)
features.does: Public records for a domain or website (certificates, registration, open services), never a person; SAVE TO LIBRARY.

features.name: The car
say: find the oil filter on my car
features.does: Your car in 3D from its public facts, with lift the cover, section view, fault lights, FIND IT ON THE CAR with the camera, and steps.
features.note: Every number is a first estimate.

features.name: Measure
features.does: Sizes from a photo using a bank card, an A4 sheet, a door, a distance, or AUTO depth.
features.note: AUTO needs a one-time 50 MB download, on your tap on Wi-Fi. Every size is a first estimate.

upward.why: Scrub back through the last hours of quakes, storms, radar and flights: a replay of the world.
upward.builds_on: the radar frames, quake and event feeds already kept

upward.why: Pin up to nine favourite public cameras into one live wall that remembers itself, like a control room.
upward.builds_on: the CCTV grid and the camera card

upward.why: One tap for COMMUTE (traffic, incidents, cameras), STORM (radar, alerts) or SKY (planes, satellites, ISS) instead of many switches.
upward.builds_on: the layers sheet and its saved choices

upward.why: A gentle nudge ten minutes before the ISS or a bright satellite passes over home.
upward.builds_on: the pass times already on the card and in THREATS

upward.why: What changed today against yesterday, with a weekly summary in the Brief.
Typing 'BA' shows every matching flight, ship and place to pick from, not just the first hit.
Walk around a thing and get width, height and depth together, with the uncertainty said.
upward.builds_on: MEASURE's AUTO depth and the 3D measure code

upward.why: MOT, service and tyre dates kept on the phone, with what is due next shown on the car.
upward.builds_on: the car pane and his plate's public facts

upward.why: Finishes the one gap: the route drawn even with no signal.
upward.builds_on: the journey planner and the offline map pack

upward.why: It reads what is under the crosshair and the nearest thing as the view moves.
upward.builds_on: the readout line and the tap cards

upward.why: The globe drawn in half the time, with a still picture until it is ready.
Keep the last minute of a public camera's stills as a short timelapse on the phone, for his own viewing.

sideways.why: Follow a flight by number from take-off to landing, with its route line and arrival time.
sideways.builds_on: the aircraft layer, FOLLOW and search

sideways.why: Point the phone up to see the planets, the ISS and the constellations overhead.
sideways.builds_on: the satellite layer and the Lens camera

sideways.why: A full-screen radar with the next two hours played forward, for home and his places.
sideways.builds_on: the RAIN RADAR layer and the map sheet

sideways.why: Quiet or scenic routes with the climb shown, from open map data.
sideways.builds_on: the map sheet's routing and its topo and cycle styles

sideways.why: A free public air quality map on the globe and in THREATS.
Environment Agency flood warnings and river gauges near his places.
sideways.builds_on: the alerts layer and NEAR HOME

sideways.why: Open charger and fuel station maps near a route or his car.
sideways.builds_on: the map sheet and the car

sideways.why: Live departures for his station and the trains on the map.
sideways.builds_on: the BUSES & TRAMS layer and the journey planner

sideways.why: A day out on the topo map with distance, climb and sunset time.
sideways.builds_on: the topo map, measuring and the sun maths

sideways.why: Measure a room by photo and get a floor plan to use in Space.
sideways.builds_on: MEASURE and the room plan code

sideways.why: Open car park data near a spot.
sideways.builds_on: the map sheet and THIS SPOT

cross.idea: Trip mode: the agenda's next event becomes a journey with weather, road reports and cameras along the way
cross.why: One tap from an appointment to everything about getting there.

cross.idea: The world in the morning Brief: threat level, his commute's incidents and a still of his road's camera
Point the Lens at a landmark, then fly God's Eye there with Street View
cross.why: From what he sees to the whole place around it.

cross.idea: Geography lessons on the live globe: quakes, plates and weather systems with real data
cross.why: Learning with the real world, not pictures.

cross.idea: A car fault becomes a workshop job sheet with parts and steps
cross.why: From a warning light to a plan to fix it.
